title: W3C Devices and Sensors Working Group-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by W3C Devices and Sensors Working Group

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AmbientLightSensor

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Remove the reference to #enable-generic-sensor-extra-classes

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

Several MDN pages referencing Generic Sensor APIs instruct developers to enable the Chrome flag:

#enable-generic-sensor-extra-classes

However, this flag no longer exists in recent versions of Google Chrome.

As a result, the documentation is outdated and may confuse developers trying to test or experiment with these APIs.

One example is the AmbientLightSensor page, which still references this flag. There may be similar references across other Generic Sensor API pages.

What did you expect to see?

Suggested change

  • Remove references to #enable-generic-sensor-extra-classes
  • Review related Generic Sensor API pages for similar outdated flag mentions
  • Update implementation/support notes to reflect the current status in Chrome, Edge, Opera, etc

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

No response

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
